title: Analyzing an Argument, Evidence, and Revision
subject: rla

standards.framework: 19 TAC §110.24 (Grade 8 English Language Arts and Reading)

primary.focus: analyze the author's claim and how the argument is developed in an argumentative text
evaluate whether the evidence supporting a claim is relevant, sufficient, and credible
revise a draft to strengthen support and improve clarity and focus
